variableDeclarations.description: Variable for CONNECT_A2A_Prompt

schema.default:
"A customer is contacting support regarding a potential issue with their internet service. Investigate the following devices and identify the root cause, if any, and the appropriate dispatch decision.
"
   "Devices in the customer's home: {mac_addresses}

"
   "Respond ONLY with valid JSON — no extra fields.
"
    "Use EXACTLY this structure:
"
    "{{
"
    "Analysis": "<high-level summary: scope, impairment pattern, and root cause only — no recommendation>",
'
    "Severity": "<Critical | High | Medium | Low>",
'
    "Recommendation": {{
'
    "Technician Type": "<Network Tech | Install and Repair Tech | No Technician Required>",
'
    "Remediation": "<brief action to resolve the issue>"
'
    }}
'
    "}}

"

variableDeclarations.description: Speed Test flow control: 'true' after an asynchronous speed test has started and before both download and upload completed result events have been retrieved.

variableDeclarations.description: Speed Test flow control: 'true' after the assistant offered to run a speed test (and confirmed the account is eligible), awaiting the customer's yes/no before running it.

variableDeclarations.name: speed_test_execution_enabled
variableDeclarations.description: Speed Test execution feature flag: 'true' enables customer-requested gateway speed-test start/poll execution; any other value disables the Speed Test flow and responds that speed tests are not supported right now.

variableDeclarations.name: speed_test_restart_offer_pending
variableDeclarations.description: Speed Test flow control: 'true' after a speed test result recommended a gateway restart and the assistant offered it, awaiting the customer's yes/no.

variableDeclarations.name: video_flow_enabled
variableDeclarations.description: Video Troubleshooting MASTER FEATURE FLAG (P0). 'true' enables the additive Video/TV/X1 troubleshooting capability. ENABLED in this environment (default 'true') to serve the Video/TV/X1 flow. Every Video entry point is gated on this being 'true'.
